learning_outcomes.text: Can define basic sound and vibration terms.
Can explain the arithmetic of calculations related to sound, noise, and vibration with examples.
Can explain the criteria used in evaluating sound, noise, and vibration.
Can describe the quantification of sound.
Can explain the effect of vibration and noise on humans.
Can perform basic noise and vibration isolation calculations.
Can comprehend the content of noise standards in Turkey and Europe.

syllabus_topics: Basic Concepts related to Noise, Sound, and Vibration
Quantification of sound, sound power, pressure, intensity, Level, dB, RMS etc.
Human perception of sound, NC, PNC, NR, Lt, Leq, SEL
Human perception of sound, NC, PNC, NR, Lt, Leq, SEL
Sound power levels of industrial noise sources
Sound propagation in free and reverberant fields
Regulations for sound and noise in open and closed areas, Use of Measurement Devices
Noise control with walls, cells, and barriers
Design of machine feet for vibration
Introduction and use of Vibration Measurement Devices
assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of 20% homework, 50% in-term achievement, and 50% final exam. The total contribution of semester activities (homework) is 20%.
